about.headline: I build, break, and ship things at 14.
about.body: Hi, I'm Aarav. I started coding before most kids my age learned algebra. Today I build full-stack web apps in Python (Flask/Django/Kivy), craft prompts that bend AI to my will, and ship PHP backends that just work. I won 1st place at the DWPS Mindsphere Competition, got an honorable mention at Intel's Ctrl+Alt Hackathon, and became a Global Nominee at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025-26. My superpower? Prompt engineering. My vibe? Code fast, ship faster.
